about.title: The Art of Baking
about.paragraph1: Since 2018, Gateaux Patience has been creating exceptional pastries in Sidi Bel Abbès. Every creation is the fruit of a deep passion for culinary art and artisanal know-how passed on with love.
about.paragraph2: Our philosophy: every cake should be as beautiful as it is delicious. We use only premium quality ingredients to guarantee an unforgettable taste experience.

faq.title: Your questions
faq.a1: Pick a design in the gallery, or bring your own idea, then message us on WhatsApp: together we settle the size, flavor and decoration.
faq.a2: The size, flavor, decoration, colors, theme and the message written on the cake.
faq.a3: Our workshop is in Sidi Bel Abbès, Algeria.
faq.q4: Can you write a message on the tiramisu?
faq.a4: Yes: on the Tiramisu page, you type your message and see the result live before ordering.
faq.q5: Where can I see more of your cakes?
faq.a5: The whole gallery is right here on the site, and our latest creations are on Instagram ({handle}).
faq.a6: The price depends on the size and decoration: ask for your quote on WhatsApp.
